A roasted hearty radish. Fragrant and warm, it has no special effect but will restore hearts.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Roasted Radishes are a type of [[Roasted Food]]. They are made when [[Hearty Radish]]es are toasted by [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]].{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 295}} While they offer no [[Added Effect]]s, they are considered to be fragrant and warm. Eating one recovers three and three-quarters [[Heart]]s to [[Link]]'s [[Life Gauge]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== Roasted Radishes reappear in {{TotK}} and are again a variety of [[Roasted Food]]. They can be made by exposing [[Hearty Radish]]es to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. While they offer no [[Added Effect]]s, they are considered to be fragrant and warm. [[Link]] can eat one to heal three and three-quarters of a [[Heart]] to his [[Life Gauge]]. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Hearty Radish * Roasted Big Radish * Roasted Food }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Roasted Food |items= BotW, TotK }}
